info.title: E-commerce API
info.description:
REST API for the modular E-commerce application (auth, products, categories,
inventory, orders, notifications).

**Authentication** — obtain a JWT from `POST /api/v1/auth/login` (or `register`)
and send it as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` on every protected endpoint.
Click **Authorize** and paste just the token.

All responses use a common envelope: `status` (1 = success, 0 = error),
`data`, `message`, `status_code`, `timestamp`. List endpoints add a
`pagination` object.

get.description: Scaffolded `apiResource` route. The controller currently returns a view / empty body and does not yet produce the standard JSON envelope. Documented here only so the route is visible.
Returns the order with its line items. A non-admin user may only view their own orders.

403.description: You are not allowed to view this order

get.description: Admins see all orders; regular users see only their own. Paginated (15 per page).

post.description: Creates an order for the authenticated user. Stock is checked and decremented; prices come from the database, not the request.

403.description: You are not allowed to update order status

get.description: Lightweight endpoint returning just the order id and current status. A non-admin user may only track their own orders.

403.description: You are not allowed to track this order

status.description:
Central OpenAPI document definition.

This class holds no logic — it only carries the global OpenAPI attributes
(info, servers, security scheme, tags) and the reusable component schemas
that the per-controller endpoint annotations reference. l5-swagger scans
this file (it lives under the configured `app/` annotations path) when it
generates the spec with `php artisan l5-swagger:generate`.

bearerAuth.description: JWT obtained from the login/register endpoints.
